_comment: 2019 DESTINATION: DEEP SPACE. Filled from the manual for the end-to-end beta test.
_units: every *_s field is SECONDS (int); every points field is POINTS (int).
name: DESTINATION: DEEP SPACE (2019) -- beta test
auto_s_source: manual s5.2 p41: 'The SANDSTORM PERIOD is a fifteen (15) second period at the start of each MATCH (T-minus 150s ...)'
teleop_s_source: derived: 150 s match minus the 15 s SANDSTORM PERIOD (manual s5.2 p41)
endgame_s_source: INFORMATIONAL. 2019 had no separately-defined endgame phase; HAB climbs conventionally occur in the closing ~30 s. Enters no arithmetic.
_cycle_actions_note: DEEP SPACE has TWO repeatable scoring actions -- CARGO (3) and HATCH PANEL (2). Only cycle_actions[0] is modelled. CARGO is the dominant one by value, so it is modelled here; the HATCH half is combined by hand in REVIEW.md s2. Note a HATCH must be present before CARGO counts in a BAY, so a pure-CARGO robot is not actually viable alone -- a real constraint this schema cannot express.

cycle_actions.name: CARGO into a BAY
cycle_actions.points_auto_source: manual Table 5-1 p42 (CARGO = 3, no AUTO/TELEOP distinction)
cycle_actions.per_cycle_source: ASSUMPTION -- a DEEP SPACE round trip delivered one game piece. Not a manual fact.

fixed_actions.name: HAB Climb Level 1
fixed_actions.points_source: manual Table 5-1 p42 HAB Climb Bonus: Level 1

fixed_actions.name: HAB Climb Level 2
fixed_actions.points_source: manual Table 5-1 p42 HAB Climb Bonus: Level 2

fixed_actions.name: HAB Climb Level 3
fixed_actions.points_source: manual Table 5-1 p42 HAB Climb Bonus: Level 3
fixed_actions.time_s_source: ASSUMPTION -- L3 was slow and failure-prone in practice

rp.name: HAB Docking
rp.threshold_source: manual Table 5-1 p42: 'earning at least fifteen (15) HAB Climb Bonus points' = 1 RP
rp.note: Alliance-wide. 15 pts = three L1 climbs (9) is NOT enough; needs e.g. L3+L2 (18) or L2x2+L1 (15).

rp.name: Complete ROCKET
rp.threshold_source: manual Table 5-1 p42: 'completing at least one (1) ROCKET with six (6) scored HATCH PANELS and six (6) scored CARGO' = 1 RP
rp.note: 12 = 6 HATCH + 6 CARGO on ONE rocket. The threshold is a co-ordination requirement, not a volume one -- the model treats it as 12 cycle units, which OVERSTATES how reachable it is.
